items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch, conditional for ordinary bounded reversible growth, and counsel_required for rights-dependent monetization or data use. Evidence: compliance is a technical baseline only, with 35 pass, 18 fail, and 6 unknown; analytics quality is yellow with source-permission or collector errors; revenue evidence is limited to 2026-09-21 aggregate Amazon commission of $4.92 that is not site-attributable; security, operations, accuracy, freshness, attribution, and owner gates remain incomplete. Do not treat incomplete telemetry as zero or as a blocker to ordinary growth when no new data collection, rights-dependent use, claims expansion, or privacy change is introduced. Exact decision: maintain containment-only execution, preserve private and parked launch gates, reject public launch, monetization expansion, external outreach, new telemetry, spend, deployment, and unchanged requeues. Human counsel must review any upstream rights request, public data display, affiliate or advertising use, or material privacy/jurisdiction question.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 remain open. Progress is evidenced by official source documentation, public terms, support documentation, repository/configuration artifacts, privacy and cookie-policy artifacts, and draft terms. No task is closed because rights, field permissions, retention, deletion/correction/access workflows, notification consent, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence remain incomplete. Exact decision: keep the gated product private and preview-only; keep rights outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data — blocked; missing current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance, storage, caching, display, derivative, alert, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete an internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized request. User alert rules and sync results — evidence_needed; missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics — evidence_needed; missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional treatment. Smallest next action: capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling new tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data — evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, incident handling, and data-subject request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only log, vendor, and incident inventory and route counsel-required gaps.

Remain parked, private, and preview-only. Do not publish, deploy, alter DNS, configure analytics, monetize, spend, add dependencies, or enter the queue. Existing owner-gap work remains active. Next evidence action: attach a dated packet for each parked scaffold covering execution-owner verification, preview/build evidence, compliance and security checks, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blocker by 2026-09-30T17:00Z. Reconsider launch only after that packet and the required technical, security, measurement, and legal gates are evidenced.

Compliance failures and unknowns require site-specific remediation or evidence where a release depends on them, but incomplete telemetry alone does not block ordinary growth. Analytics is yellow and unavailable sources must remain unavailable rather than zero. Amazon evidence covers one day only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; attribution is partial and the aggregate row cannot be assigned to a site. Do not claim site revenue, ROI, margin, payback, forecasts, causal lift, or monetization performance. Preserve affiliate disclosures, consent and cookie disclosures, privacy and terms, data provenance and rights, claims accuracy, copyright/trademark boundaries, platform-policy limits, and age-sensitive safeguards for any retained work.
